tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /blo ldan thos pa'i lam la bskul ba'i dbyu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed drod gsher gyis/ /nye bar bskyangs pa'i lam bza
༄༅/ /blo ldan thos pa'i lam la bskul ba'i dbyu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed drod gsher gyis/ /nye bar bskyangs pa'i lam bza

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /blo ldan thos pa'i lam la bskul ba'i dbyu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed drod gsher gyis/ /nye bar bskyangs pa'i lam bzang gser sgong dbus/ /legs 'thon spangs rtogs gshog rtsal yongs rdzogs pa/ /zla med ston pa nam mkha' lding khyod rgyal/ /rtag tu brtson pa'i rlung shugs la brten nas/ /mang thos rnam dpyod 'brel ba'i 'dab gshog zung*/ /rab brgyangs gzhung mang zab don yangs pa'i mkhar/ /bgrod mdzad 'phags bod paṇa chen tshogs rnams bsngags/ /gang dag phyogs re'i lam gyis mi tshim par/ /ris med mang thos don gnyer skyes bu 'ga'/ /spro ba bskyed pa'i thabs zhig 'dir brjod kyi/ /gzu bor gnas rnams rna ba blags te nyon/ /'di la gnyis/ thos pa 'tshol dgos par sgrub pa dang*/ /de la rtsod pa spong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ blo ldan rnams kyis gang la 'jug par bya ba'i gzhi de la mang du yod kyang*/ gtso bo ni thos bsam sgom gsum ste/ bsam sgom tshul bzhin du byed pa ni thos pa la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /des na thog mar thos pa la 'jug pa gal che bar nges so/ /'o na/ thos pa gal che bar lung gang gis 'grub par ston cig ce na/ de la sgrub byed kyi lung mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang 'dir cung zad brjod pa ni/ thos pa la 'jug dgos pa'i tshul lung du mas 'grub pa yin te/ chos bzhi pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu chos bzhi dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab dang ldan zhing myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' thos pa mang ba yin/ thos pa 'dzin pa yin/ thos pa bsags pa yin/ zhes pa nas/ chos ston pa la brtson pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar thos pa 'tshol zhing de ltar thos pa yongs su 'tshol ba na/ mthong ba'i chos kyi shes rab 'phel bar byed na 'jig rten pha rol lta smos kyang ci dgos te/

/shes rab de yang thos pa nan tan du byed pas sgrub pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ shā ri'i bu gang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi phyir byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dag thos pa mang po la mngon par brtson par mi byed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' bden par smra bar ma yin par rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ mang du thos pa las shes rab 'byung ba yin te/ shā ri'i bu de bas na khyod kyis mngon sum du bya zhing khyod kyis so sor rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed nas thos pa mang po la mngon par mi brtson pa gang yin pa de ni bdud sdig can gyis byin gyis brlabs pa nyid yin no/ /zhes dang*/ 'od srung gis zhus pa las/ mang du thos pa las shes rab 'byung bar mthong nas mgo'i gos la me 'bar ba bzhin du thos pa 'tshol zhing*/ zhes dang*/ theg pa chen po la dad pa'i mdo las/ mang du thos pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi snod spyad dang 'tshog chas dang yo byad do/ /zhes dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ tshangs pa theg pa chen po gces sbras su byed pa'i chos gnyis te/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad la khro ba med pa dang*/ thos pa yongs su 'tshol ba la ngom mi shes pa ste/ 'di dag go /zhes dang*/ byang sems blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ gces spras su byed pa'i chos gnyis te/ thos pa'i nor kyis mi ngoms pa dang*/ thos pa'i shes rab kyis ngoms mi myong ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ gzhan yang gsum ste/ thos pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ tshig dang yi ge rnams 'dzin pa dang*/ sgra la sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' yongs su ma chad par shes pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa las/ /thos pa thams cad 'dzin pa ni shes rab kyi rtsa ba'o/ /don la rtog pa ni shes rab kyi las so/ /zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ thos pas shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/

/shes rab kyis ni don rnams dpyad/ /zhes dang*/ dkon brtsegs las/ mang du thos pa rgya mtsho 'dra/ /shes rab mchog ni thob pas na/ /des na 'ching ba gcod par byed/ /zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gal te tshul khrims dregs pas de rgyags shing*/ mang du thos la brtson par mi byed na/ /tshul khrims 'bras bu ma lus zad nas ni/ /phyir yang sdug bsngal rab tu myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dkon brtsegs las/ bsod nams kyis brgyan pa'i thos pas ni byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na mdzes so/ /thos pas brgyan pa'i spobs pa ni skye bo mang po nye bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis ni thos pa yongs su 'tshol lo/ /zhes dang*/ khyad par du stong nyid zab mo la thos bsam byed pa ni phan yon lhag par che ba yin te/ de nyid las/ thos pa 'di ni sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'dra'o/ /thos pa 'di ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang 'dra'o/ /thos pa 'di ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang dang 'dra'o/ /zhes sogs du ma gsungs pa rnams shes dgos pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ thos pa'i tshoms las/ /thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par byed/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong*/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob/ /ces pa dang*/ mi ni blo gros ldan gyur kyang*/ /sdig pa dang ni dge ba'i chos/ /ma thos bar du shes mi 'gyur/ /mig ldan mar me yod pa yis/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba mi lta bar/ /de bzhin dge dang sdig pa'i chos/ /thos pas rnam par shes par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ thos pa mang zhing chos 'dzin dang*/ /shes rab ldan zhing mnyam bzhag pa/ /de dag sus kyang smad 'os min/ /zhes dang*/ skyes rabs las/ gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur nas/ /legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /shes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'gyur/ /rang gi shes kyang de nyid nyo ba'i rigs/ /thos pas gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/

/rkun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun du rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /nyes pa chen po'i dpung 'joms dpung gi mchog /grags dang dpal dang gter gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying bor byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ sred med kyi bus zhus pa las/ rigs kyi bu thos pa dang ldan na shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab dang ldan na nyon mongs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang yum gyi mdo las/ mang du thos pas mi ngoms shing de la yang yi ger mngon par mi zhen pa dang*/ zhes dang*/ 'dul ba las/ thos mang thos ldan thos srung mtho ris nyid/ /ces dang*/ mang du thos pa mthong ba bde/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ rje btsun byams pas mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ / zhes dang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung*/ / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa goms las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung*/ /zhes dang*/ yang byams pas/ shes rab mchod yin de gzhi ni/ /thos pa de phyir thos pa mchog /zhes dang*/ /mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ skra dkar gnyer ma lhag dus su'ang*/ /thos pa bsags par bya ba ste/ /gang du thos pa 'gro 'gyur ba/ /der ni phung bo 'gror mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ rgyan bdun dgrol ba las/ dang po nyan pa'i shes rab kyis/ /tshig gis rgyud la thos pa bskyed/ /ces dang*/ don gsal las/ thog mar thos pa'i don la 'bad pa yis/ /rtag tu brtson par byed pa gang yin pa/ /de yi lag tu dngos grub legs par 'thob/ /zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor pa chen pos/

sangs rgyas sgrub pa la po ti mdzo khal tsam pa la bya ba ma byas par/ lag mthil tsam pa zhig ston pa tsug sped tsug byas pas gar yang mi phyin/ zhes dang*/ gdam ngag la nang byan chud pa ni/ be'u bum lag mthil tsam zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la mi zer gyi/ gsung rab thams cad gdam ngag tu go ba la zer zhes dang*/ lam rim chen mo las/ sgom pa byed pa la thos bsam gal che bar gsung rabs dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas gsungs pa yin gyi/ /zhes dang*/ de nyid las des na thos pa ci tsam mang ba de tsam du de las byung ba'i shes rab mang la de tsam du bsam pa mang ba dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ chos tshul bzhin sgrub par 'dod pa rnams la lam gyi srog dam pa chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab bskyed pa'i rgyu bla na med pa dri ma med pa'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos mang du thos pa dgos so/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de ltar sgrub pa la shes rab dang de'i rgyur thos pa med du mi rung ba la nges pa rnyed dgos te/ zhes sogs dang*/ dang po nas mi shes na yang ma zhus par mi bya bar blo dang bstun pa'i thos pa che chung gang 'thad re la 'bad/ ces dang*/ bsten 'os bla ma rim 'gro bsnyen bkur te/ /shes rab bsgrub phyir thos pa btsal bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhas pa bsten nas nus pa dang bstun pa'i thos pa re bya dgos te/ de med na thos pa las byung ba dang bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab mi skye la/ de lta na ci zhig bsgom pa mi shes pa'i phyir/ thos pa byas na de'i don bsams pas bsams byung gi shes rab skye la/ de las sgom byung gi shes rab yangs pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ de yang thos byung gi shes rab kyi sngon du thos pa dang*/ bsams byung gi shes rab kyi sngon du bsam pa 'gro dgos/ zhes dang*/ sngags rim chen mo las kyang*/ rang gis sgrub pa dang gzhan la ston pa sogs gang byed kyang thog mar thos bsam gyis go ba ma nor ba cig btsal dgos te/

/rang gis mi shes na gzhan bston mi nus pa'i phyir/ zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ thos pa 'dzin pa slob ma dam pa yin/ /zhes rim lnga'i lung drangs pa dang*/ yang rje bla mas/ 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i g.yang sa 'gegs pa la/ /dri med mang du thos la brten pa yi/ /zhes sogs dang*/ thub pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa'i mang thos kyis/ zhes sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la dmigs pa'i 'chad pa dang zhes sogs kyi smon lam dang*/ der ni mang du thos pa'i mthar son nas/ /zhes sogs kyis smon lam 'debs par mdzad pa sogs mang du thos dgos pa rje bla ma'i gsung kho nas bsgrubs kyang 'grub na gzhan lta mi smos pa'i phyir ro/ /mkhas pa gzhan gyis mang du thos dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa yod kyang 'dir tshigs mang bar dogs nas ma bris so// //gnyis pa de la rtsod pa spong ba la/ kha cig na re/ thos pa la 'jug dgos pa khyod kyis lung gis bsgrubs mod/ 'chad pa'i tshe thos pa dgos pa bden gyi/ nyams len la mang du thos pa mi dgos so zhe na/ de ltar 'dod pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ dpal ldan dpa' bos/ thos nyung dmus long sgom pa'i tshul mi shes/ /de med de ko ci zhig bsam par bya/ /zhes dang*/ mu tig 'phreng ba las/ blo gros med la thos med mthos la'ang bsam pa med/ /zhes dang*/ bslab btus 'grel ba las/ thos pa dang mi ldan pas ni bsam gtan gyi thabs dang nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs mi shes te/ zhes dang*/ sha ra bas/ thos pa rgyun mi chad du bya snyam du bsam/ sgom pa po la mi dgos bshad pa po la dgos snyam ste 'chad pa po la sdig tu 'gro nyen che/ sgom pa po kho na la dgos/ zhes sogs kyis nyams len byed pa la thos pa dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la kho na re/ thos pa mang du byas te go ba 'chags mi dgos kyi/ de med par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byas pas chog go zhe na/ de yang mi 'thad de/ go ba legs par ma 'chags par yun ring du bsgoms kyang don chung ba'i phyir dang*/

go ba nor na nyams len kyang nor bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar yin te/ lam rim las/ go bas dmigs ma phyed par phur tshugs re la 'bad pa'i myong ba tham thom gyis gar yang mi phyin te/ zhes dang*/ sngags rim las/ go ba nor na sgrub pa nor la sgrub pa ma nor ba yang go ba ma nor ba la rags las pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig /thos pa la 'jug dgos kyang*/ mang du thos pa mi dgos te/ mang du thos pa dang nyung ngu thos pa'i gang zag gnyis nyams len la zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'thob tshul 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /zhe na/ de yang phyin ci log tu smra ba yin te/ lam rim chen mo las/ des na thos pa ci tsam mang ba de tsam du de las byung ba'i shes rab mang la de tsam du bsam pa mang ba dang de mang tsam du de las byung ba'i shes rab mang ba dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ gsung 'bum thor bu las/ nyi tshe ba la nyi tshe dang*/ /mtha' dag pa la mtha' dag pa'i/ /'bras bu 'grub par gsungs pa'i phyir/ /shes ldan su zhig phyogs re tshim/ /zhes khyad par yod par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang*/ thos pa la 'jug dgos pa tsam du ma zad mang du thos pa la yang 'jug dgos te/ lam ma nor bar sgrub pa la mang thos mi dgos zhes brjod pa ni ngag kyang lam cal col gyi gtam yin pa'i phyir dang*/ thos bsam ma byas par bsgoms byung gi blo mi 'byung bar chos mngon pa las bshad pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang lam rim las/ lam ma nor bar bgrod pa la mang du thos pa mi dgos ces pa'i cal col yang legs par smras par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs dang*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa'i rang bzhin can gyi shes pa skye ba'i rim gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar thos pa byas pa'i dgos pa ni sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i ched du ma zad/ gnas skabs shes rab bskyed pa'i ched yang yin te/

shes rab ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi yon tan du ma 'grub pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mthong dang ma mthong yon tan 'di/ /kun gyi rtsa ba shes rab yin/ /de ltar gnyis ka bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /shes rab yongs su bzung bar bya/ /chos don 'dod dang thar ba yi/ /'byung gnas rig pa chen po yin/ /de ltar dang por gus pa yis/ /shes rab yum chen bzung bar bya/ /zhes dang*/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ brtson 'grus gcig po byas pa ngal ba'i mtha'/ /shes rab grogs kyis bskyangs na don chen 'grub/ /ces gsungs pas so/ kho na re/ nang rig pa'i sde snod la thos bsam byed dgos pa bden gyi/ sgra snyan ngag rtsis sogs phyi'i rig gnas la thos bsam byed mi dgos so zhe na/ de yang rigs pa ma yin te/ rang nyid kyis de dag la thos bsam byed mi nus pas mi 'jug ces brjod na ma gtogs/ gzhan du na lung dang 'gal zhing rigs pa dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lung dang 'gal te/ rje btsun byams mgon gyis mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de bas gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes su bzung phyir dang*/ /rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /zhes dang*/ sa paṇa gyis/ rig pa nang bar 'chi yang bslab/ /zhes skye 'phags gang yin kyang rig gnas la bslab dgos par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rig pa dang 'gal te/ rig gnas de dag lam sbyangs pa'i 'phags pa med pa'i phyir te/ gal te/ yod na ni/ de nyid blun po yin par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ 'phags bod kyi paṇa chen mkhas pa rnams kyis rig gnas du ma la sbyangs 'dug kyang tshul de mi 'thad ces smod rigs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rtag zur dang po grub ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ /'phags pa'i lam mngon du gyur na yang rig pa'i gnas lnga la legs par sbyangs pa zhig 'dod dgos te/

de lta ma yin na 'phags pa de dag blun po yin par thal ba'i skyon yong zhing*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ rtog pa'i yon tan brjod byar ston byed pa'i/ /lung gi bstan bcos 'ga' yang mi shes par/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras su khas len na/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag nges par brdzun/ /zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ blo gros dbang phyogs lha yi lam yangs nas/ /lung dang rigs pa'i skya rengs ma shar bar/ /rtogs pa'i rta ljang rgyu ba'i ngang tshul rnams/ /rgyu 'bras mi shes dam pa'i skyes bu mtshar/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ de la smod par mi rigs na/ tshul de 'thad ces rang cag kyang mkhas pa de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i kha yar blta'i bya ba byed rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang*/ de ltar 'dod pa ni ches mi rigs te/ 'dul ba las kyang lnga phrug nyer gcig gi skabs su mang thos kyi yon tan la phyi rol ba'i bstan bcos mang du thos dgos pa'ang bshad pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ rig gnas thun mong ba zhes pas kyang phyi nang gnyis kas slob dgos par 'grub pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ kha zas bzhin no/ /yang kho na re/ phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas la sbyangs kyang sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur te thun mong ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /snyam na/ de yang 'thad pa ni ma yin te/ phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas yin kyang thos bsam byed pa po'i sems skyed kyis zin na sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'i phyir te/ de skad du lam rim chen mo las/ de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i phyir du 'tshol ba ni bye brag med pa'o/ /zhes rig gnas lnga po sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i ched du thos bsam byed dgos par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rgya mtshos kyang*/ tha snyad rig pa la'ang theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin na bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gro'o/

/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta ma yin na/ gzhan la kha zas sbyin pa yang sangs rgyas 'thob ba'i thabs su 'gro ba mi srid de/ de ni phyi nang dang thun mong bar ma zad 'jig rten phal pa rnams dang yang thun mong ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes smras na ci zer/ kho na re/ skyon med de/ sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bya rog lta bu la zan chang gcig ster pa yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gro ba srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na/ cig shos la yang rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so/ /mdor na ji skad du/ dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtor ba dang zhes bshad pa ltar 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi nang du thos pa 'gro bas kyang thos pa gal che zhing khyad par rje bla ma'i rjes 'brang rnams kyis gsung rab kyi tshig don mang du thos pa la 'bad dgos te/ kun mkhyen ye shes zhes grags pa de ni/ thos bsam bsgom pa'i stobs las byung zhing ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad mkhyen pa zhig la byed kyi/ rmongs pa'i rgyu las ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ kho na re/ lung gi yon tan med kyang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i sku'i skye ba du ma snang bas/ de ji ltar yin snyam na/ skyon med de/ 'ga' zhig ni/ tshe snga mar thos bsam byas pa'i dbang gis rtogs pa'i ston byung ba yin zhing*/ gang zag khyad par can tha mal pa'i tshul bzung ba la la ni lung gi yon tan med pa'i tshul bstan kyang de med pa yin la/ gzhan phal cher ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa chen pos/ mi shes gdol pa'i phru gu dar zab kyis/ /phar phung mdzes par byas te mthon po'i khrir/ /blun po'i 'khor tshogs dbus na 'gying ba yi/ /ba mos thub bstan pad tshal bcom gyi dogs/ /chos spyod bcu yi sgrub pa rgyab bor nas/ kha grag dpung dang rgyu nor g.yo khram gyis/ / 'gro ba'i phan bde sgrub par rlom byed na/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i gtso de 'khrul bar nges/

/zhes gsungs pa lta bu min pa'i nges pa ci zhig yod/ yang kho na re/ mang du thos pa dgos na ni/ 'o na/ spyod 'jug las/ lus kyis legs par spyad par bya/ /tshig tsam brjod pas ci zhig phan/ /zhes sogs dang*/ jo bo rjes/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang zhes sogs dang*/ lho brag phyag rdor gyi rnam thar las kyang*/ kha yi chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa de ci ltar yin zhe na/ skyon med de/ de ni nyams len med pa'i thos pa tsam dang kha phyir blta'i bshad pa tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa'i gang zag la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang thos bsam phal cher nyams len yin par gzhung du ma las bshad do/ /'o na/ khyed rang thos bsam sgom gsum de bzhin byed kyin yod dam/ gzhan du na de ltar brjod mi 'os so zhe na/ kho bo cag lta bus sngar bshad pa ltar thos bsam sgom gsum byed nus pa dka' yang*/ kha cig mang du thos pa tshol mi dngos snyam pa dang*/ khyad par rig gnas thun mong ba la 'jug mi dgos snyam pa 'byung srid pas de dag gi log rtog 'gog pa dang*/ blo gros dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig thos bsam la bskul ba'i ched du bgyis pas mkhas pas gzigs na dgongs khrel mi 'jug par 'tshal lo/ /smras pa/ 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /yon tan khyad par can rnams 'grub pa'i gzhi/ /shes rab yin te de rgyu thos pa ru/ /gsungs phyir de la 'bad pas 'jug par rigs/ /de tsam kho nas sangs rgyas mi 'grub kyang*/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis las/ /lung gi bstan la thos pas 'jug dgos par/ /gsungs pa yis kyang thos pas bstan la phan/ kwa ye khyim pa rnams dang dud 'gro yi/ /spyod pa'i tshul bzhin lto dang gos tsam zhig /gtso bor bsgrub pa'i ched du mi 'jug par/ /dam pa'i rjes 'gro thos bsam bsgom la 'bad/ /ci phyir zhe na rab tu byung ba yi/ /dgos pa de min byang chub sgrub pa'i ched/

/tshul de lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa la/ /thos bsam bsgoms pas 'grub kyi gzhan la yin/ /gang dag thos pa spyi dang khyad par du/ /thun mong rig gnas rnams la mi 'jug ste/ /dgos pa med ces dngos su brjod byed pa/ /gang des dam chos spong ba byed min nam/ /'on te thos pa kho nas mi chog gi /thos don ci 'os nyams su len dgos zhes/ /'doms par byed na dam pa'i legs bshad de/ /de la mi 'thad sus kyang smra mi nus/ /thos pa'i tshul la cung zad 'dris byas kyang*/ /bag med brlang por spyod pa'i mkhas blun dag /mig can g.yang la 'jug dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /de la sangs rgyas byon kyang ci zhig bya/ /'dir 'bad las byung dge ba mchis gyur na/ /des ni gzhung lugs kun dang nang don la/ /mang du thos don tshul bzhin bsam pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed gyur cig /ces smra ngan glang bo skrod byed blo ldan thos pa'i lam la bskul ba'i dbyu gu zhes bya ba 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne dgon nyid du sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis// //
